• • This guide provides general information about income tax returns in Japan. • In this guide, income tax and special income tax for reconstruction are referred to as income tax etc. • The outlines indicated by [ ] are available for Japanese text only. 2023 INCOME TAX AND SPECIAL INCOME TAX FOR RECONSTRUCTION GUIDE The filing period of your taxable income in the period of the calendar year 2023, is open; From February 16 (Fri.) through March 15 (Fri.), 2024 - NOTICE - If you have your Individual Number for Social Security and Tax (“My-Number”), you need to write your number in your return form. You also need to present your identification documents or attach copies of them. (see page 68) Example of identification documents e. g. 1 Individual Number Card (“My-Number Card”) e. g. 2 Notification card of the Individual Number and Driver's license or Passport etc. TAX OFFICE • You are advised that you file your final return and complete the payment before March 15 December 31. • When you can receive a tax refund, the Tax Office accept your final return before February 15 (Thu.), 2024. A final return, appendix, statement, etc. are available for download from our website (https://www.nta.go.jp). 1 CONTENTS 1 Introduction 3 1- 1 Flow of final return procedures 3 1- 2 What is the final return? 5 1- 3 Taxpayers and the scope of taxable income 5 1- 4 Types of Income & Taxation Methods 10 1- 5 Who needs to file? 11 1- 6 Who is eligible for a tax refund? 12 1- 7 Place for Tax Payment 13 2 How to Fill out Your Final Return 14 2- 1 Cautions for filling in the return form 14 2- 2 Form (Page 1 and 2) 14 2- 3 STEP 1 Name and address, etc. 16 2- 4 STEP 2 Amount of earnings etc. / Amount of income, etc. 18 2- 5 STEP 3 Deductions from income 26 2- 6 STEP 4 Calculating your tax 43 2- 7 STEP 5 Other items regarding the Page 1 49 2- 8 STEP 5 Notification of postponement of tax payment 50 2- 9 STEP 5 Where to receive your refund 50 51 2-11 STEP 6 Items about inhabitant taxes and enterprise taxes regarding the Page 2 2-10 STEP 5 Registration and use of public money receiving account 53 3 Information good to know about filing tax return & payment of tax 58 3- 1 Taxation methods for the interest income and the dividend income 58 3- 2 How to enter the retirement income etc. 60 3- 3 In Case of Suffering from Disaster 60 3- 4 In Case Tax Payment is Delayed 60 3- 5 In Case of Mistakes on a Tax Return 61 3- 6 Estimated income tax etc. prepayment and Application for reduction of estimated tax prepayment 61 3- 7 Obligation to file consumption tax return and necessary report 62 3- 8 Report of Assets and Liabilities / Report of Foreign Assets 63 3- 9 Special measures provided by international tax treaties etc. 63 3-10Notice to those leaving Japan during 2024 64 3-11Notification of Tax Agent for income tax / consumption tax 65 3-12Notification 66 3-13 Notification from Local Governments 67 4 Documents to be attached or presented 68 5 Application (notification of change) for tax payment by transfer account 71 How to fill out the tax payment slip 72 2
